question: When do inauspicious actions become pure?
premises: the guru rooted in self-awareness acts by force
when inauspicious actions become pure then auspiciousness follows
inference: By the guru's forceful power rooted in self-awareness, destruction occurs; when inauspicious actions become pure, then auspiciousness follows.
plain_english: By the force of the guru rooted in self-awareness, destruction occurs; when his inauspicious actions become pure, then auspiciousness follows.
